target: DuplexCascade as German Frankenstein 2.0 full-duplex candidate versus architecture donor
generation_reason: A newly identified 2026 VAD-free cascaded full-duplex system is materially different from the generation-1 speech-native candidate set and generation-2 AEC prerequisite: it may transfer turn-control architecture while independently failing German production-language support.
question: Does current primary-source evidence support DuplexCascade as a German-capable local production voice candidate for Frankenstein 2.0, or only as an architecture donor for micro-turn and explicit WAIT/RESPOND/BACKCHANNEL control?
falsifiers: The released model or official runtime does not establish German ASR/TTS/dialogue support.
The published real-time stack depends on English/French speech backends rather than German speech I/O.
The full-duplex control mechanism cannot be separated conceptually from the released Qwen2-7B model and speech stack for use as an architecture donor.
The source does not actually expose VAD-free micro-turn control with explicit conversational control semantics.
